subcmd.provider: Provider plugins: list, log in, log out and run the conformance kit
provider.cli.usage:
Usage: chatcli provider <command> [flags]

Commands:
  list                         Installed provider plugins and their login state
  login <name> [--input id=v]  Log in to a provider plugin (flags answer prompt fields for unattended use)
  logout <name>                Revoke and delete a provider plugin's credential
  test [flags] <plugin> [args] Run the conformance kit against a plugin binary

test flags:
  --input id=value        answer an auth/login prompt field (repeatable)
  --credential-file path  JSON credential to use instead of logging in
  --model id              model for the chat checks (default: first listed)
  --timeout 30s           per-check timeout
  --json                  print the report as JSON
